description:
Head turning, mind blowing
Our top of the range ELyte EVO Stag Works is the dream bike of our design and engineering team, made real for you. With a full carbon frame, our lowest centre of gravity ever for the finest, most capable handling, mixed (MX) wheels (29er front, 27.5in rear), the latest Bosch CX motor and integrated top-tube display, a new Fox Float 36 Factory fork and a wired-in rear mech, our latest ELyte EVO Stag Works delivers the very best mountain bike handling and ride feel with full-power capability so you can get more out of every ride: more runs, more grins, and more fun.

Highlights
– 150mm front + 142mm rear of custom-tuned suspension travel.
– Uni-directional carbon fibre frame is light and reassuringly strong.
– Bosch's fifth generation Performance Line CX full-torque full-power motor.
– Ready for the latest software upgrade to unlock E-MTB+ mode (July 2025), plus 100Nm torque + 750W peak power (available October 2025).
– 650Wh of combined battery (400Wh internal + 250Wh PowerMore range extender) so you can ride further.
– MX wheels (29er front, 27.5in rear) so you can tackle the techiest terrain.
– 492.28mm complete bike centre of gravity for the best handling possible.

No compromises, no half measures
The ELyte EVO Stag Works is specced to perform flawlessly from the shop floor so you can focus on what really matters: getting the most from your ride. Top-shelf Fox Factory suspension front and rear tames the roughest trails with ease; SRAM's XO T-Type AXS electronic gearing gives you reliably impeccable shifting performance; Hope’s latest richly powerful EVO GR4 four-piston hydraulic disc brakes deliver the ultimate in braking control; Hope cranks and hubs; traction-rich Maxxis tyres; and more. It’s the finest trail-proven kit to serve you perfectly, wherever and however hard you ride.

Charge time: 50% in 1.5hrs from empty, and to 100% in 3.5hrs.

ELyte EVO Stag Works: time saver, fun maker.

Bosch Performance Line CX (Smart System) drive unit with 100Nm maximum torque, 600W of peak power (rising to 750W in October 2025 via a software update) and 250W of nominal power. Features four power mode settings including Tour+ and eMTB+. AXS derailleur powered off motor.

Bosch Kiox 400C LCD display mounted within the top tube, paired with the discrete bar mounted Mini Remote. Also connects to the Bosch eBike Flow smartphone app to give you even more insight and control at your fingertips.
